registers.basis: I — Reveal the top card of your library. If it's a permanent card, put it into your hand.
III — Other creatures you control get +2/+2 and gain trample until end of turn.

deferred.claim: Cast Esper Origins at its printed cost; surveil, gain life, and return transformed with a finality counter if cast from a graveyard.
deferred.basis: Surveil 2. You gain 2 life. If this spell was cast from a graveyard, exile it, then put it onto the battlefield transformed under its owner's control with a finality counter on it. (If a creature with a finality counter on it would die, exile it instead.)

deferred.claim: Cast Esper Origins from the graveyard for its flashback cost, including its surveil, life gain, transformed return, and flashback exile replacement.
